name: Opening & closing
strength: You greeted Dan, acknowledged the confusion, and closed with a clear recap.
improvement: Open with a greeting and a little reassurance, and close with a recap of what each charge was.

name: Use Dynamics
strength: You verified the payment method and, since Dan was on a different email, collected the card details before looking the charge up in SBS.
improvement: Verify the payment method first, and when the caller is on a different email than the card, collect the card details before you look up the charge.

name: Familiarize
strength: You asked a contextual question that put Dan at ease and gave you useful background.
improvement: Ask an impactful question that puts the caller at ease and gives you context, rather than a generic or account-only question.

name: Clarify the issue
strength: You pinned down the exact dates and amounts, and checked for other services, before drawing any conclusion.
improvement: Confirm the exact dates and amounts, and check for other services, before you conclude it's a duplicate.

name: Roadmapping
strength: You told Dan your plan for what you'd check and do next.
improvement: Tell the caller your plan, what you'll check and do next, so they're not left guessing.

name: Article / Copilot
strength: You confirmed the answer in the right source of truth, Billing Common Scenarios or Payments for Wix Services, instead of relying on memory.
improvement: Open the right source of truth, Billing Common Scenarios or Payments for Wix Services, to confirm renewal versus retry versus duplicate, instead of relying on memory.

name: Recreate the issue
strength: You verified the two charges yourself, reviewing the plan and payment history in User Manager and comparing the invoice billing periods in SBS, before explaining.
improvement: Confirm the two charges yourself, review the plan and payment history in User Manager and compare the invoice billing periods in SBS, before you explain the outcome.

name: Solve the issue
strength: You explained clearly that it wasn't a duplicate, using the invoice details and the retried failed payment, and documented your findings in the internal note.
improvement: Explain that it isn't a duplicate, using the invoice details and the retried failed payment, and document your findings in the internal note before you close.
